title: helianthemum vulgare var. hirtum
intro: Helianthemum vulgare var. hirtum, commonly known as hairy rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Cistaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of hairy rockrose include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds may help to protect against oxidative stress, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against various pathogens.
